final_consonant.signal: final consonant deleted or glottal stop

s_ed_ending.signal: suffix phones missing when target text is known

final_voicing.signal: final voiced obstruent heard as voiceless pair

cluster.signal: vowel inserted in cluster or member deleted

sibilant.signal: substitution among s z ʃ ʒ tʃ dʒ

consonant_sub.signal: substitution inside v/w/j, z/j/dʒ, l/n/ɹ, p/b

vowel_length.signal: vowel heard as other member of the tense/lax pair

vowel_quality.signal: substitution among æ ɛ ʌ ɑː; diphthong heard as one vowel

word_stress.signal: duration + loudness + pitch per syllable vs expected stress

weak_form.signal: strong vowel in a weak-form slot

linking.signal: glottal stop, pause or inserted vowel at a link
